items.title: Mayor's County Council Report
notes: Mayor Watters indicated the County of Wellington Planning Committee was presented with a report regarding on May 11, 2023. He indicated the report provides a summary of key changes proposed in the draft PPS and also includes County staff comments on some of the consultation questions asked by the Province. Mayor Watters indicated staff is coordinating delegations to a future Council meeting to provide additional information.

notes: Councillor Jefferson indicated the Elora BIA is excited about the shuttle bus and is looking for creative ways to encourage people to explore East Mill, in spite of the construction.

notes: Demolition Control – 6834 Sixth Line, Former Township of West Garafraxa
Report from R. Bossence, Chief Building Official
B. Salmon, Managing Director of Planning & Development provided an overview of the demolition control by-law and process.
R. Bossence provided an overview of the report, indicating the existing house no longer meets the needs of the owners and it is their intention to remove it and rebuild a new home.

In response to a question regarding the reason why the house is not recorded on the Township Municipal Heritage Register and not designated under Part IV of the Ontario Heritage Act, Mariana Iglesias, Manager of Planning indicated many rural properties have yet to be added and changes to the legislative framework have staff revisiting the process. She indicated the condition of the house is poor and deterioration extensive.

motions.text: THAT the additions and corrections to the agenda be adopted as presented.

motions.text: THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington authorizes Riverfest Elora to be held in Bissell Park with amplification of music between 3:00 pm and 11:30pm on Friday August 18 and between 12:00 pm and 11:30 pm on Saturday August 19 and between 12:00 pm and 11:30 pm on Sunday August 20, subject to the organizers planning and implementing the requirements to ensure Public Safety as required by the Alcohol Gaming Commission of Ontario, Ontario Provincial Police and the Centre Wellington Municipal Alcohol Policy; AND THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington approves Riverfest Elora scheduled for the third weekend in August at Bissell Park, as a Municipally Significant Event in order to a acquire a Public Special Occasions Permit for Alcohol Service at Bissel Park from the Alcohol Gaming Commission of Ontario (AGCO); AND THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington grants and exemption from By-law 5001-05 the Township Noise Control By-law from 11:00 pm to 11:30 pm on Friday, Saturday and Sunday night.
motions.text_html: THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington authorizes Riverfest Elora to be held in Bissell Park with amplification of music between 3:00 pm and 11:30pm on Friday August 18 and between 12:00 pm and 11:30 pm on Saturday August 19 and between 12:00 pm and 11:30 pm on Sunday August 20, subject to the organizers planning and implementing the requirements to ensure Public Safety as required by the Alcohol Gaming Commission of Ontario, Ontario Provincial Police and the Centre Wellington Municipal Alcohol Policy; AND THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington approves Riverfest Elora scheduled for the third weekend in August at Bissell Park, as a Municipally Significant Event in order to a acquire a Public Special Occasions Permit for Alcohol Service at Bissel Park from the Alcohol Gaming Commission of Ontario (AGCO); AND THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington grants and exemption from By-law 5001-05 the Township Noise Control By-law from 11:00 pm to 11:30 pm on Friday, Saturday and Sunday night.
